career_ladder.note: Key administrative and secretarial ministerial cadre within Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL) headquarters and distribution/transmission zonal offices. Executive Assistants manage correspondence, clerical drafting, documentation, and office automation, advancing through departmental promotions and seniority.

steps.designation: Executive Assistant / Camp Assistant Grade-III (Karyakari Sahayak)
Senior Executive Assistant / Camp Assistant Grade-II

exam_scheme.note: Selection process comprises a 3-part examination: Part 1 NIELIT CCC-level computer knowledge qualifying test (50 marks, 20 marks minimum required), Part 2 Written Test (CBT of 180 marks across 4 subjects), and Part 3 Computer Typing Skill Test in Hindi (Kruti Dev 010/016 font) carrying 20 marks upon achieving minimum 30 wpm.

financial_package.note: Executive Assistants in UPPCL are placed in Pay Level 4 (Entry Basic Pay ₹27,200 per UPPCL revised pay structure corresponding to Grade Pay ₹2,600). Employees receive DA, HRA, and concessional power units.
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on UPPCL Level 4 entry basic pay of ₹27,200 with 58% DA (₹15,776), HRA (₹2,400 to ₹5,400 depending on Lucknow/Discom headquarters posting), electricity concession, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹4,298) and standard insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP PSU rules
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by district posting
Concessional electricity power unit quota for corporate employees
Medical treatment reimbursement for self and dependent family members
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Leave encashment, gratuity, and group personal insurance benefits
